attempts.summary: Set up automated one-way sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2 using a pull-based cron job over SSH, running every 5 minutes (well within the 15-minute requirement). Verified the sync works both via manual invocation and via the actual cron trigger. Then performed the mandatory sequential restart of both nodes and confirmed full recovery of services, cron persistence, and data consistency, including a live post-reboot automated sync test.
